Outdoor areas / GOLD COAST

Maintaining outdoor dining areas

Paving, access, drainage and presentation considered together.

Ellis Services Group · Maintenance notes

We assess an outdoor dining area as a working part of the venue. We check the agreed paving, doors, fixtures and drainage points, and ask how tables, deliveries and customer routes use the space. The scope should explain both the repair and the area that needs to be unavailable.

Gold Coast's stormwater guidance identifies runoff from roofs, car parks and other surfaces as part of the local drainage system. Where water collects around a commercial outdoor area, we inspect the accessible drainage route and surface condition before defining the repair. Cleaning, local surface repairs and drainage alterations are separate tasks.

We confirm materials, curing or drying requirements and the sequence with the venue manager. Cleaning water and waste handling are included in the planning. We finish with a record of completed work and the agreed arrangements for returning the area to use.
